translation_snapshot.source:
You smack your forehead against your enemy's head (or whatever sensitive part you can find), causing %0.1f Physical damage.
		If the attack hits, the target is confused (%d%% effect) for %d turns.
		Damage done increases with the quality of your headgear, your Strength, and your physical damage bonuses.
		Confusion power increases with your Dexterity, and chance increases with Accuracy.
translation_snapshot.target:
你用前额猛击敌人头部（或者任意你能找到的有效位置），造成 %0.1f 物理伤害。如果
		此次攻击命中，则目标会混乱(%d%% 强度) %d 回合。
		伤害受头盔品质、力量和物理伤害加成。
		混乱强度受敏捷加成，几率受命中加成。

translation_snapshot.source: You cannot use Eldricth Fury without a shield!
The diminutive skeleton of a giant rat, charged with evil energies. Nobody understands the usefulness of undead rodents until several of them come after you.
translation_snapshot.target: 一只被邪恶能量支配的巨大老鼠骨骼。在它们追赶你之前，没人知道亡灵啮齿动物的可怕。
